title: Vanilla Optimized
description: A lightweight Fabric vanilla+ optimization pack
body:
# Vanilla Optimized – Lightweight Fabric Survival

A vanilla-friendly optimization modpack on Fabric 26.1.2, inspired by Better MC 
but staying true to core vanilla gameplay — no bloat, just smoother survival.

Unlike heavy Forge packs, this pack only adds QoL and performance mods. 
Vanilla balance is untouched; what changes is how it feels.

##  Highlights

- **Vulkan Renderer** – bypasses OpenGL limits for modern GPU throughput  
  (official beta Vulkan in 26.2+; for 26.1.2 this pack bundles a dedicated Vulkan mod)
- **Deep optimization** – FerriteCore + Lithium for drastically lower memory footprint
- **Visual polish** – Better Health Indicator (clear mob HP), improved entity animations
- **Mob animation overhaul** – smoother, more lifelike creature movements
- **First-person enhancement** – better hand sway, item holding, and camera feel
- **Punchy** – satisfying hit feedback and combat impact
- **Biomes** – Terralith for grand, seamless transitions, 100% vanilla blocks
- **Light exploration** – Trek adds natural ruins & structures, no quest books
- **Simple Music Control** – enhanced music player with hotkeys
- **QoL** – backpack, vein-mining, map, JEI, cleaner UI feedback
- **Fabric-native** – lightweight, fast load times, no gigabytes of bloat

##  Controls

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| **`~`** (Tilde) | Activate vein mining (Liteminer) |
| **B** | Open backpack (Traveler's Backpack or alternative backpack mod) |
| **M** | Open map (JourneyMap or Other map mod ：keys kept consistent across versions) |
| **F9** | Skip to next music track (Simple Music Control) |
| **F10** | Pause / resume music (Simple Music Control) |
| **Shift + Right Click** | Pick up a mob (Serverside CarryOn) |


> **_Note: If a specific mod version is unavailable, functionally equivalent alternatives are used with the same keybindings wherever possible._**

##  Who is this for?

Players who want the Better-MC-style glow-up but **don't want** recipes, 
combat, or progression touched. Pure vanilla survival, just smoother.

## ##  Specs

- **Minecraft**: 26.1.2 / 26.2+
  - 26.1.2: bundled dedicated Vulkan mod
  - 26.2+: official built-in Vulkan renderer (stable path)
- **Loader**: Fabric
- **RAM**: 4 GB recommended (FerriteCore helps on lower-end)
- **Server compatible**: Yes
##  Core Mods

Vulkan Mod · FerriteCore · Lithium · Terralith · Better Health Indicator · Trek · 
Liteminer · Traveler's Backpack (or equivalent) · JourneyMap / Xaero's Minimap · 
Simple Music Control · JEI · Mob animation mod · First-person model tweaks · Punchy
